jobMapping.description: [Deprecated] Mapping of JobIDs to node selectors for pod scheduling

^[0-9]+$.description: Node selector configuration for a specific JobID. Each property represents a Kubernetes node label (key-value pair).

additionalProperties.description: The value for a node label. Must follow Kubernetes label value format (RFC 1123).

propertyNames.description: Node label key. Must follow Kubernetes label key format (RFC 1123 DNS subdomain).

jobProfiles.description: Advanced scheduling profiles for specific JobIDs. Allows defining nodeSelector, tolerations, and affinity.

jobIndexes.description: Per-job index volume settings. "default" holds the settings every job starts from; entries under "jobs" are deep-merged over it field by field. A job only gets a volume when its index_required advanced setting is true.

jobs.description: Per-JobID overrides, deep-merged over "default" field by field.

size.description: Requested volume size, e.g. 50Gi. Grow-only; Kubernetes rejects shrinking.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for the index PVC. Empty falls back to global.storageClass, then the cluster default. Must be block storage.

accessModes.description: Access modes for the index PVC.

mountPath.description: Mount path inside the connector container.

cacheSizeMB.description: Pebble block cache size in megabytes, passed to the connector as OLAKE_INDEX_DB_CACHE_SIZE. Resident memory inside the connector pod, per stream.

maxOpenFiles.description: Maximum SSTable file descriptors Pebble keeps open, passed to the connector as OLAKE_INDEX_DB_MAX_OPEN_FILES.

labels.description: Labels merged into the index PVC. These override the worker's app.kubernetes.io/* defaults; only olake.io/job-id is reserved. Merged per key with the "default" entry rather than replacing it.

annotations.description: Annotations applied to the index PVC, for backup tooling and similar. Merged per key with the "default" entry rather than replacing it.

existingClaim.description: Name of an existing PVC to mount instead of provisioning one.
